proposed_widenings.name: modify_carrying_capacity
proposed_widenings.justification: Powerful Build changes only carrying-capacity determination by treating the creature as one size larger. The current surface has no effect atom for carrying-capacity math, and modeling this as an actual size change would be false.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "You also count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity."

notes: The trait's first rider fits existing passive mechanics via modify_roll_advantage on ability_check with conditionFilter grappled, but the carrying-capacity rider cannot be encoded honestly. Per protocol, no content or trace files were authored.
